# NFL Rushing Yards API Merge V1

This certification is limited to connecting the NFL Rushing Yards page to the Kyre Sports API.

Permanent protections:

- Certified NFL Passing Yards files and math remain frozen.
- Official ESPN event, athlete, and team IDs are authoritative.
- Fuzzy name identity is forbidden.
- Synthetic event/player IDs are forbidden.
- Rushing Yards model/projection/market/EV/grading logic remains OFF.
- Sportsbook projection influence remains 0.0%.
- Stake sizing remains OFF.
- A verified pregame event may return `data_available=false` until exact-event rushing boxscore rows exist.
- Transport errors and schema/identity violations fail closed.
